description:
From the fz-kdt.107 step-3 review (2026-09-01): the prototype's first
sweep showed 3 interp-only regressions (matched-no-member /
missed-exhaustive-dispatch) because tuple_arities_at_every_depth did
not recurse through LIST HEADS -- a tuple arity appearing only inside
a head was unregistered and the head's tuple test rejected while JIT
stayed green (three-path parity break, one line to fix). File the
CONSTRUCTIVE gate: every arity reachable through any sub-predicate
(tuple positions AND list heads AND whatever the next nested axis
adds) is registered -- so the next axis extension cannot repeat the
break. Lands with or immediately after 107.3.
title: Every arity any sub-predicate can reach must be schema-registered: a constructive invariant
